speaker: thomas_pope
text: If we are rehearsing, let us rehearse. I have heard the gate from three mouths already. I do not need it from a fourth before I have said a line.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are rehearsing. Richard the Third, from the entrance with the drum. The street is not in the book. If the street makes a noise, we hear it and we stay.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I can stay. I want it plain that I can hear a shout from the road at this door, and that I am choosing not to go to it.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Noted, without a number. One shout is one shout. I am not pricing it.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: There. And here I still am, which is the achievement of the minute. Give me the cue.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cue stands. Again. Eyes on the man you are answering, not on the door to the lane.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Eyes on Pope. I have learned that much this week, if I have learned nothing else. Door, hand, bar, and now a face.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: My face is not a lesson. It is a target for your line. Say the line.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: That second one is not ours. Ours is the drum. I can tell them apart. I am telling you so you do not stop to sort them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Don't stop. The scene does not owe the road a silence. Go on from the drum.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Going on. I want it said that going on is not the same as not having heard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have heard. We have all heard. We are not going down. That was settled before this started. The drum is the work.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I will hit the speech harder than the road can. If I am loud enough, the yard this afternoon will hear me and not a memory of a gate.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Loud is not a figure I can check. Say it once more from the drum, and I will tell you if the outside noise took a word. It did not take one, the last time.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: From the drum. And if another shout comes, I will look at Pope and not at the lane. I said I would not go. I am not going.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the rehearsal. Unusual, because we are listening outward and playing inward. It is still a rehearsal. At two we do the play.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: At two I will be loud. The gate can be open without my help.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: I have nothing to add to the list from the stair. People running toward the noise. We are not among them. That remains true at this door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then leave the list. Once more, the entrance only, and then we stop while the stopping is still ours.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Once more, then. The drum, and Pope's face, and the lane can shout if it likes.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Let it shout. I have a speech, and the speech is indoors.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Indoors. No new figure. We can stop on that.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stop, then. The entrance is done. The lane has not become a scene.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: It has not. I am still on this side of the door.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And I will be loud enough at two. That will do.
